pulse.text: **GPT-5.6's late-June window keeps collapsing** — Polymarket's June-30 ship odds slid again to **31%** (from 47% last sweep) while the July-31 line firmed to **94%**, so OpenAI's still-uncard'd, still-silent flagship is now overwhelmingly a July story. Otherwise a **quiet 12 hours**: no new models and no ranking changes, with **Claude Opus 4.8 still #1 at AA-Index 56** (v4.1 scale), ahead of GPT-5.5 at 55 and Gemini 3.1 Pro at 46, and Anthropic priced at **93.6% to hold best-model at end-June** (64% at end-2026; Google 14%, OpenAI 10%, xAI 8.5%). Fable 5 and Mythos 5 remain offline under the US export order. The freshest news is all buildout — **SpaceX signed a ~$6.3B compute deal** with startup Reflection for Nvidia GB300 capacity at Colossus 2, and Anthropic's standoff with Washington escalated. Watch whether GPT-5.6 or Google's still-pending Gemini 3.5 Pro lands first as June runs out.
